input: We're bringing up a new SoC with ARM C1-Ultra, C1-Pro, and C1-Nano cores in a 1+3+4 big.MEDIUM.LITTLE configuration. The EAS scheduler keeps placing heavy tasks on C1-Nano instead of C1-Ultra. The energy model shows all three tiers but the capacity values seem wrong — C1-Nano shows capacity 512 and C1-Ultra shows capacity 800. How should we calibrate the Energy Model for this 3-tier C1 setup, and does the runtime-modifiable EM (Linux 6.9+) help us tune this without rebuilding the kernel?
